email.subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – custom domain connection
email.body_text:
Hi Arjun,

Thank you for your time on our call. You wanted your custom domain to load your funnel instead of showing a "site can't be reached" error. Here is a quick summary so you have everything in one place.

What we resolved:
- Your custom domain is now connected, and both the main address and the www version load your funnel.
- Your secure certificate is now fully set up and the padlock is showing, so your visitors will see a secure site.

What we covered:
- We explained that the old record was blocking the connection and had to be replaced with a CNAME record.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-02

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Sameer
FlexiFunnels Support
